verdict.rationale: Zep's core product is presented as a cloud/enterprise service ('governed Context Lake', 'Deploy anywhere: Cloud, Your VPC') with only a VPC self-host option mentioned, not clear in-process/embedded local operation. However, Graphiti — the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework underlying Zep — is documented as usable to 'build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally', suggesting a local-first path exists via that component. missing for 10: explicit docs on running the main Zep memory server fully offline/in-process, confirmation of local LLM/embedding model support (no cloud API calls), and independent verification that VPC/self-host deployment removes all cloud dependency.
